text: I usually don't write reviews but the service I received from Dr Pop was just so exceptional that I wanted to write about it here. I have been to another 5 star rated acupuncture clinic in Chiang Mai and there was a huge difference in outcome of the procedure making Dr Pop the best I have ever worked with. I've been experiencing chronic lower back pain for like 20 years. Dr Pop listened deeply and was really trying to understand my situation and how to help me best. As a result, her treatment was super precise and targeting my deep back muscles instead of just the superficial ones. After the treatment she thoroughly assessed my decline in pain and when I still felt pain in some regions, she immediately targeted this region, too. For the first time in my life I feel an effective relief of back pain by about 60%, no treatment so far has been this effective after only one run. I cannot recommend her highly enough. Thanks so much Dr Pop!
